verdict.rationale: A game-engine editor could plausibly ship an AI assistant that consumes MCP tools, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Godot acting as an MCP client. The community MCP projects noted in the probes (e.g., Coding-Solo/godot-mcp) are third-party servers that expose Godot to outside agents, which is the opposite role. Editor plugins and the built-in GDScript language server are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit here.
